items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I called Shep, I said, ―Come out here and get me. They left me.‖ ... Shep drove me up, and that was my introduction to Steeplechase.

ctx.x: Actually, you clarified the first one who . . .

Yes. We went . . . Walter Booker, Billy Hart were in the band. We went to California. I wanted to drive, so there were two cars. Boogie had his friend with him, has me and Billy in the car. We drove, and I wanted to stop and look at everything, the snake farms. I mean, I was having a ball. They wanted to hurry up and get there. Anyway, we were there two, three weeks.
